text_block_list.text:
Having safely made her debut, Symboli 
Rudolf decides to run in the Saudi Arabia 
Royal Cup next to ensure she is in top 
form for the Classics.

Handling interviews and Student Council 
duties calmly even immediately after a 
race—that was Symboli Rudolf's pride as 
President, and as the "Emperor."

Remarkably capable, she rarely relied on 
her Trainer. Even so, the Trainer resolved 
to provide her with the best support 
possible to help her achieve her dream.
